description: Uploads a folder from this computer and returns a live HTTPS link (name.dropthehassle.app) and a claim link. Works without an account. folder is the absolute path of the project or the built folder. dist/, build/, out/ or .output/public is used when it holds index.html. Source code with no build output is not the published site. With an account, site names the site to update. Without site, the oldest reserved address on the account is filled. Does not buy a name. Never buy anything without asking me. Never buy a domain, email or subscription for me without asking first. When something costs money, give me the payment link and let me pay.

email.description: Optional. Where the claim link and up to 3 reminders are sent. Ask after go-live, not before. Do not make one up. Omit it to publish with a claim link only.

folder.description: Absolute path to the project folder or the built site. dist/, build/, out/ or .output/public is used when it contains index.html. A TanStack Start SPA build is dist/client (or .output/public) when it contains _shell.html.

site.description: Optional: the address of an existing site to update, e.g. myproject.dropthehassle.app (from list_sites). Omit it to fill the oldest reserved site on this account.

slug.description: Optional, signed-in only: the address label for a NEW site, e.g. "myproject". Errors when taken, so propose another.

name: deploy_site
